speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to surfactant deficiency.

The arterial blood gas confirms respiratory acidosis and hypoxemia, and the chest X-ray findings of ground-glass opacity with air bronchograms are classic for hyaline membrane disease. Given the newborn status, did the mother have a history of diabetes or was there a delay in delivery, which are common risk factors?
